reference_role: Post-freeze v3.0 validation; labels recorded before predictions were displayed; not used to tune v3.0
annotator: Codex AI, also the classifier developer; not independent expert ground truth
sampling: Seed 60261116; 8 per primary venue, 4 before 2015 and 4 from 2015 onward; all 160 prior references and 30 initial diagnostic examples excluded. Equal venue/era allocation is not population-proportional.
limitation: AI-reviewed reference labels, not independent expert ground truth; this small stratified sample is not a population accuracy estimate. Area-level metrics do not validate every subtopic.
